jobs.description: Are you fluent in German and looking for a new career opportunity in the Netherlands? Undutchables helps German-speaking professionals find their next job at international companies across the country. We have a wide range of vacancies where your German language skills are highly valued. Opportunities are available in areas such as Customer Service, Sales, Finance, Administration, Logistics, Marketing and other specialist roles. Whether you already live in the Netherlands or are considering making the move, there are opportunities for different levels of experience. Many of our clients are international companies where you can work in a multicultural and English-speaking environment, while using your German skills on a daily basis. What we are looking forWe are looking for German-speaking professionals who are motivated to take the next step in their career. Depending on the position, you may need fluent German alongside English and/or Dutch. Your previous experience, skills and ambitions will determine which opportunities are the best fit for you. Why work through Undutchables?Undutchables specialises in connecting international professionals with companies in the Netherlands. Our consultants know the Dutch job market and can help you find a position that matches your experience and career goals. Ready for your next step in the Netherlands? Explore our German-speaking vacancies and find the opportunity that suits you.
